exposure: Ultrasound detection of fetal middle cerebral artery resistance index (RI)
Ultrasound detection of fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (PI)
Ultrasound detection of fetal middle cerebral artery ratio of peak systolic blood flow velocity to end-diastolic blood flow velocity (S/D)
Ultrasound detection of umbilical artery resistance index (RI)
Ultrasound detection of umbilical artery pulsatility index (PI)
Ultrasound detection of umbilical artery ratio of peak systolic blood flow velocity to end-diastolic blood flow velocity (S/D)
cohort: The study included 30 pregnant women diagnosed with fetal distress (observation group) and 60 normal pregnant women (control group).
finding: Combined ultrasound detection of umbilical artery and middle cerebral artery hemodynamics with fetal movement reduction demonstrated the highest diagnostic value for fetal distress, with individual markers also showing specific diagnostic utility.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of assessment for fetal distress.
